dog.description_text: Hi, my name’s Boston! I’m 4 years old and was rescued in Queens. I’m pretty shy when I first meet people, but I’m a real sweetheart, I promise! I might be timid, but I’m fascinated with feather toys—a feather on a wand, a feather on a string—I’m not picky! Playing with me is a great way to see my endearing, playful, and curious personality start peaking through! One thing to note is that I am FIV+, so I’m hoping to find a parent who can look past that and welcome me into their loving home! All I want is to be cherished by my forever family. If that sounds like you—patient, loving, and willing to see all I have to offer—then apply for me today! I’ll be waiting!
dog.name: Boston
